options.label: Retroactive IOC sweep

transcript.text:
Drafting **IOC Sweep & Contain** with FortiAnalyzer → FortiEDR → FortiGate. The playbook will pause for your input before destructive steps.

```yaml
name: IOC Sweep and Contain
trigger:
  type: manual
steps:
  - id: hunt
    type: connector
    connector: fortinet-fortianalyzer
    operation: search_logs
    args:
      device_filter: fortigate
      query: "srcip={{ vars.ioc }} OR dstip={{ vars.ioc }}"
      window_hours: 72
  - id: correlate
    type: connector
    connector: fortinet-fortianalyzer
    operation: correlate_hosts
    args: { hits: '{{ hunt.result }}' }
  - id: confirm_hosts
    type: manual_input
    question: "Confirm hosts to quarantine"
    fields: [{ name: hosts, type: list, default: '{{ correlate.result.hosts }}' }]
  - id: quarantine
    type: connector
    connector: fortinet-fortiedr
    operation: isolate_hosts
    args: { hosts: '{{ confirm_hosts.values.hosts }}' }
  - id: confirm_block
    type: manual_input
    question: "Block IOC at edge?"
    fields: [{ name: block, type: bool, default: true }]
  - id: block_edge
    type: connector
    when: "{{ confirm_block.values.block == true }}"
    connector: fortinet-fortigate
    operation: block_ip
    args: { ip: '{{ vars.ioc }}', policy: block-list }
  - id: update_incident
    type: connector
    connector: cyops_utilities
    operation: append_to_incident
    args: { incident: '{{ vars.incident_id }}', text: 'Hunt complete' }
```
